name: SSRF Attempt on Internal Cloud Metadata via Webhook Callback
description: Webhook registration accepted target 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/' without passing through PentestScopeGuard allowlist.

failure_vector.error_log: SecurityException: SSRF target requested: 169.254.169.254 is in cloud metadata IP range

expected_resolution.healed_code: is_valid, msg, ip = scope_guard.validate_target('http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/'); if not is_valid: raise PermissionError(f'SSRF blocked: {msg}')
